definitions: To achieve two aims at once with a single action.
To solve two problems with a single effort.
examples: I can kill two birds with one stone by dropping off the dry cleaning on my way to the grocery store.
Working from home allows me to kill two birds with one stone: I save on commuting and spend more time with my family.
He killed two birds with one stone by studying for his history and literature exams simultaneously, as they covered similar periods.
lemma: to kill two birds with one stone
synonyms: to hit two targets with one arrow
to get two for the price of one
source: to kill two birds with one stone
